description.value: The Curry Cottage is a locally family-owned Indian fusion restaurant in Comox, BC, blending authentic East Indian spice traditions with West Coast culinary creativity. All produce and meat are sourced locally, cooked in small batches using family recipes with no preservatives, food colouring, or MSG. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming stop with a vegetarian lunch buffet, takeout service, and a menu that includes gluten-free and vegan options.
